description: Defines the PdfCryptFilter class for handling cryptographic filters in PDF security, including initialization, encryption, decryption, and configuration of crypt filter methods and parameters.

classes.name: PdfCryptFilter
classes.description: Represents a crypt filter dictionary used in PDF security handling, supporting encryption configuration and processing.

classes.name: PdfCryptFilter.Keys
classes.description: Contains predefined keys for the crypt filter dictionary, such as CFM, AuthEvent, and Length.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the security handler interpretation of the length key.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToNone
methods.description: Configures the crypt filter to handle encryption by the security handler without encrypting data itself.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToRC4ForV4
methods.description: Configures encryption with RC4 for PDF version 1.5 using a specified key length.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToAESForV4
methods.description: Configures encryption with AES (128-bit) for PDF version 1.6.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToAESForV5
methods.description: Configures encryption with AES (256-bit) for PDF version 2.0.

methods.name: CheckLength
methods.description: Validates the length value based on the crypt filter method.

methods.name: SetAuthEventForEmbeddedFiles
methods.description: Sets the authentication event key to /EFOpen for embedded files.

methods.name: PrepareForProcessing
methods.description: Initializes encryption and decryption settings before processing the document.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Encrypts data bytes according to the crypt filter method.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Decrypts data bytes according to the crypt filter method.

methods.name: SetCryptFilterMethod
methods.description: Sets the crypt filter method and updates the dictionary element.

methods.name: GetCryptFilterMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the current crypt filter method from the dictionary.
